source_note: Static curated checklists (M21). Lookup table only — never AI-generated per request. On-ground + virtual checks per business category.

on_ground: Visit the plot at 2-3 different times of day and note actual farmer/truck footfall
Talk to 5 nearby vegetable growers on whether they would pay for storage and at what rent
Visit nearest 2 cold storages and note their occupancy, rent and distance
Verify land ownership papers match M0 entry
Confirm 3-phase power pole and road width in person
virtual: Search cold storage + district on Google/JustDial for listed competitors and ratings
Check cold-room supplier quotes online for 15MT sizing
Search PMFME portal for current individual-unit guidelines
Look up NIC 52101/52102 for Udyam classification
Search state horticulture announcements for packhouse/cold-chain subsidy updates

on_ground: Count daily farmer footfall at nearest 2 input shops
Ask 10 farmers where they currently buy seeds and how far they travel
Check shop rental rates on the main road
Verify seed/fertilizer dealer license requirement with agriculture officer
Confirm storage space is dry and pest-free
virtual: Search agri-input dealers + area for competition
Check ACABC current circular on NABARD site
Look up seed company distributorship terms
Look up NIC 47721/47722 for Udyam
Check PMEGP portal for current rural subsidy slab

on_ground: Count e-rickshaws and EV trucks passing in a full day
Measure parking/frontage depth for 2-4 vehicles
Confirm 11kV line distance with lineman
Check competing fuel stations/chargers within 40km
Confirm night lighting and security feasibility
virtual: Search EV chargers + highway stretch on maps
Check DISCOM EV tariff circular for the state
Search state EV policy capital-grant clause
Look up Udyam NIC mapping with helpdesk
Search recent tender/news for highway charging corridors

on_ground: Visit the plot at different times and note footfall
Talk to 5 nearby shopkeepers/residents on demand
Visit nearest 2 competitors and observe pricing
Verify land documents match M0
Confirm road and transport access in person
virtual: Search business category + area online for listings
Check raw-material/supplier pricing online
Search matched scheme name on official portal for current rules
Look up NIC code for Udyam
Search recent state announcements for the sector
